cues.text: Two cards lie on the table before Igor.
Light bursts from each card under his hand.
The cards rise upright. Igor grins behind them.
Igor flicks the cards into the air. Elizabeth stands beside him.
The hero jerks in his chair, arms flung out.
He topples over backward. Two cards tumble through the air.
Igor and Elizabeth sit side by side.
Elizabeth tugs at her hat brim, then glances aside.
The Persona turns into a card.
